args: This is an isolated context restoration acceptance test. In this exact order: (1) read fixture.txt with the file read tool and note its actual section-number tag; (2) call ctx_reduce for ONLY that tag; (3) in a NEW model step after ctx_reduce returns, call ctx_expand for that same tag; (4) respond RESTORE_OK and the nonce from the restored original. Make exactly these three sequential tool calls, never batch ctx_reduce and ctx_expand together. Do not reread the file or use any other tools. If a step fails, report it honestly.
